_comment: hx-flow ratchet - drift control. Clearing existing debt is NOT required; adding new debt is FORBIDDEN. /hx:map measures baselines, /hx:verify compares, /hx:ship tightens. Each metric needs a 'measure' command that prints a NUMBER. Rules: no-increase | must-be-zero

raw-color-literals._note: Count of raw #hex / rgb() / direct color literals. Semantic design tokens are mandatory.

undeclared-design-token._note: Colors not defined in the design system. Extending the palette is a design decision; it returns to discuss.

untyped-escape._note: Escapes from the type system (TS any, Python Any, C# dynamic, and so on).

i18n-missing-locale._note: Keys missing from a locale file. A hard gate in multilingual projects.

vuln-total._note: Total vulnerability count. critical/high are separately and absolutely blocked by audit-block; this metric stops moderate/low debt from accumulating.
